items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Now, was Ed Small around at that time? INTERVIEWEE: Well, he was alive. It was his place. He was still running the club. Oh yes, he was alive.

ctx.x: My wife and I, we had a little hard time in between there, because she could not believe anybody was blowin' their horn as often and as much as I said I was at Connie's Inn, rehearsing and this-that-and-the-other. She couldn't believe anybody was rehearsing that much. And I guess the other fellows had the same trouble, too. It was tough on a wife. Real tough on a wife. But, that's the business. What are you gonna do? It wasn't the only band. There was other bands working under different strenuous conditions, too.…
I guess Small's Paradise was no different.
Well, Small's Paradise, they didn't go through all that rigmarole. They had a show. They put on a show twice a night.
